description: Dolores reveals her origins and the truth about the Demon King. The group falls into intense discussion. The Evil God's power continues to guide them as the party tries to find a way to resolve the situation.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 laid everything out on the table: the Demon King, her own origins, player4's origins, and what she had just done!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: [Image]

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Oh, is that so? Oh, so that's how it is?

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "So, this is why the King cannot have any new children..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What kind of mess is this. I don't get it, what does it have to do with me?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Whether you're the Demon King's daughters or the King's daughters..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The kingdom can't have new children? Then just have them outside the kingdom."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 looked at player3's figure. Is this the power of wish fulfillment... Discovering her own ability, she felt both joy and fear.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "...If you could just let me sleep one more time, I'd agree to anything. If not, stop the nonsense."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player5 Representing justice to eliminate you +4 1 player6 (I'm speechless, that makes so much sense)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "This is why you cannot sleep. As long as all the demons are revived, you can sleep again."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Um... Are you all talking about the same kind of sleep?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The person little player5 and little player4 wanted to kill is also dead, little Dolores seems full of energy too, isn't that great? Delightful, delightful!"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: But, after defeating the Demon King, is the adventure party still an adventure party? Can a party without a goal really stay together forever? player8 was deeply worried and distracted.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 recalled every time Dolores used healing during the journey. Did she ever harm innocent people? Can't remember...

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "player5, little Hidariva, Landriel, player2, what will you do next?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: So, the heroes defeated the Demon King and returned gloriously to the kingdom, stopping to rest at a small village along the way.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 looked at everyone with deep concern.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: But, why does the plague still exist even though the Demon King was killed?

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Immortality... does it come with a price?" player3 murmured.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Me, me?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Let's, let's eat first, everyone!" player3 hurriedly used the tavern food to distract everyone.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: A villager, seeing your distinguished group, immediately knelt before you. "Please, you're the party of heroes, right!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 scratched her head, looking a bit annoyed. "The doctor said I just have excess energy and need to expend more to treat my insomnia... I didn't understand what you were saying. But anyway, if it doesn't work, I'll just go blacksmithing."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 looked on helplessly. She could make people believe, but she couldn't create real salvation...

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "My daughter even begged me in agony to kill her, but when I cut her throat with a knife, it healed quickly."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh... The bad guy everyone talked about is dead, but the strange plague is still here..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "But this plague just won't disappear, no matter what, it can't be cured!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Ah, poor people... Unfortunately, we don't know how to cure you either..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Could it be because the 'He' mentioned by the horned bad guy is still around..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Because, after the demons died, everyone's lives returned to a state of stillness and immutability." player3 whispered to player2.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Ah... should we not have killed the horned black guy?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: ".... There's no need to care about it either."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Dolores? Do you mean that these people's suffering is completely irrelevant to you?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (Perhaps you are actually a demon.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "But the villagers seem to be in pain... little player3, do you clerics have a way to save them? It seems only a deity could have such power now."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Killing the demon, didn't you agree too, what are you saying?" player3 said gently.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "But at that time, I didn't know that killing the Demon King would lead to such a result... If I had known..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Healing someone's injuries and illnesses will cause another person to contract the disease."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Since the demons preside over death and annihilation, even the healing displayed by ordinary clerics probably means the demons bear an equivalent cost... one side is healing, the other is suffering, is it like this, waxing and waning?

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "This is the law of this world."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "But I can't bear to see them in this state where they can neither live nor die! One person suffering is better than a hundred people suffering. If I stand by and do nothing about this, then some of the beautiful qualities I have as a paladin will be lost forever!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "The reason you can't sleep is because the king bestowed upon you the greatest life energy... you possess, extrapower."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Please, please heal them..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "If all the demons are revived, you can live like an ordinary person, sleep, and then, die when you reach a certain age."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Uh... then how did you make me fall asleep?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "At that time, the Demon King had not yet died."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Disease is external, and suffering is internal. As long as this suffering has an end, disease is not something unbearable. As long as one doesn't feel they are suffering before death, isn't that fine?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player5 Representing justice to eliminate you+4 1 player6 "You—"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I don't want you to be like that either, little player5."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 stood up and walked towards the people. She was hesitating whether to fulfill player5's wish... If she fulfills it, the wish of "I love you, and everyone" cannot be realized...

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Alright. I don't understand. I just want to cure my insomnia. The doctor said I just need to do enough work to sleep. I don't want to die. Oh right, these villagers, can I help?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I don't want to see the people I like suffer."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player4 extrapower perpetual motion machine 2 fun-seeker 2 2 (Poor little Hid...)

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Ah, little player4, in short, you just need to know that the more demons there are, the better you can sleep!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Uh, but demons kill people, right. Maybe I can become a demon?" player4 said with a grin.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Intent: Persuade Dolores to sacrifice me to save everyone, Disaster: Caused the villagers to die, not betting on player6
